hooks.command: /bin/bash -p -c 'd=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}; f=$d/scripts/bughunt-worktree-hook.sh; s=0; if [ -n "$d" ] && [ "${d#/}" != "$d" ] && [ "${d//../}" = "$d" ] && [ -d "$d/scripts" ] && [ ! -L "$d/scripts" ] && [ -f "$f" ] && [ ! -L "$f" ]; then /bin/bash -p "$f"; s=$?; fi; if [ "$s" = 97 ]; then exit 2; fi; exit 0'
